name: SelectableTile

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `SelectableTile` component

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the SelectableTile should be disabled

props.name: hasRoundedCorners
props.description: **Experimental**: Specify if the `SelectableTile` component should be rendered with rounded corners. Only valid when `slug` prop is present

props.name: selected
props.description: The empty handler of the `<input>`. / onChange?(event: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement> | KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>, selected?: boolean, id?: string): void; /** Specify the function to run when the SelectableTile is clicked / onClick?(event: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void; /** Specify the function to run when the SelectableTile is interacted with via a keyboard / onKeyDown?(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void; /** `true` to select this tile.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `SelectableTile` component

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon SelectableTile rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
